reputation.summary: Pitched at OPA2134-class uses with far lower distortion. Soomal describes a 'typical OPA1642 style': refined and balanced, mild delicate mids, relaxed bass; with OPA1662 (FiiO E17K) a warm 'BB' character. Used as DAC filter or buffer in FiiO, Lotoo, Astell&Kern, HiBy, Apogee and EarMen gear, and in the Hackaday 'OPA Alice' mic.
typical_uses: DAC low-pass filter and I/V stages in DAPs, USB DACs
Line-out buffers; active filters, tone controls, mixing consoles
Phantom-powered electret mic preamps (OPA Alice; low quiescent current)
Phono (RIAA) preamps; piezo and guitar buffers
DIY DACs valuing voltage-independent input capacitance
caveats: SMD only (SOIC, VSSOP, TSSOP); DIP-8 rolling needs an adapter (e.g. Audiophonics).
Input range ends 3.5 V below V+; below ±3.5 V it excludes midsupply.
Not a headphone or 600 Ω driver: keep output under ~13 mA (2.8 kΩ min at 36 V).
Use 24–51 Ω output isolation for capacitive loads; offset up to 3.5 mV may need a servo.
VSSOP θJA is 180 °C/W; a shorted output at ±18 V dissipates over 600 mW.

counterfeit_notes: No family-specific fakes reported. TI never made a DIP version, so a one-piece DIP-8 'OPA1642' is fake; genuine DIP forms are SOIC on adapters. Genuine marks: O1641A/O1642A/O1644A (SOIC, TSSOP), 1641/1642 (VSSOP). Beware remarked JFET duals on adapters.

revision_history.changes: Initial release, Burr-Brown Audio layout. OPA1644 packages and OPA1641 MSOP-8 in product preview.
Removed product-preview information for the OPA1644 packages.
Removed product-preview information for the OPA1641 MSOP-8.
New TI format: added pin, ESD Ratings (HBM ±3000 V, CDM ±1000 V), application, layout and packaging sections. No electrical changes.
MSOP renamed VSSOP; noise, bias, VO and temperature (−40 to +85 °C specified) subsections changed; ISC added. No die change indicated.
Not a revision: orderable addendum adds '.B' duplicates (all Active), mixed VSSOP lead finishes, and -Q1 parts (unconfirmed).

revision_chains.note: Rev B probably at Kyohritsu, Octopart 10256784, Reichelt. Rev D at TI. No confirmed original, A or C copy.
Rev A at TI symlinks and DZSC; Sisoog copy is a candidate for the original.
